text.zh-CN:
脑卒中是脑部血管堵塞或破裂，导致脑组织迅速受损的急症。

- 可能突然出现口角歪斜、一侧手臂无力或说话不清。
- 也可能突然视力改变、走不稳或剧烈头痛。
- 症状自行消失仍需紧急评估，不能据此排除危险。
text.en:
Stroke is an emergency in which a blocked or ruptured brain blood vessel rapidly injures brain tissue.

- Sudden facial droop, weakness of one arm or slurred speech may occur.
- Sudden vision changes, unsteadiness or severe headache are other possible signs.
- Symptoms that disappear still need urgent assessment and do not rule out danger.

text.zh-CN:
不同类型脑卒中的直接原因不同。

- 缺血性卒中是血流被血栓等阻断；出血性卒中是血管破裂出血。
- 高血压、糖尿病、血脂异常和吸烟会增加风险。
- 房颤是心跳不规则的一种，可与血栓有关；既往短暂性脑缺血发作或卒中也提示风险较高。
text.en:
Stroke types have different immediate causes.

- Ischaemic stroke involves blocked blood flow, often by a clot; haemorrhagic stroke involves a ruptured vessel.
- High blood pressure, diabetes, abnormal blood fats and smoking increase risk.
- Atrial fibrillation is an irregular heart rhythm linked to clots; previous TIA or stroke also signals higher risk.

text.zh-CN:
怀疑脑卒中就应立即联系当地急救服务。

- 让患者微笑、抬起双臂并说一句话，任何新发不对称、无力或言语异常都应警惕。
- 突然视力丧失、失去平衡或不明原因剧烈头痛，同样需要急救。
- 不要等待所有表现出现，也不要因为症状缓解而取消就医。
text.en:
Suspected stroke requires immediate local emergency help.

- Ask the person to smile, raise both arms and say a sentence; new asymmetry, weakness or speech change is concerning.
- Sudden vision loss, loss of balance or unexplained severe headache also warrants emergency help.
- Do not wait for every sign or cancel care because symptoms improve.

text.zh-CN:
尽快进入急救流程会影响可选治疗。

- 呼叫救护车，不让患者自行开车。
- 记录症状最早出现的时间；若不清楚，如实告诉急救人员。
- 准备既往病史和用药信息，尤其抗凝药，并遵循急救调度指引。
text.en:
Rapid emergency care affects the treatments available.

- Call an ambulance and do not let the person drive.
- Record when symptoms began and tell responders if the timing is uncertain.
- Provide medical history and medicines, especially anticoagulants, and follow dispatcher instructions.

text.zh-CN:
检查需要迅速区分堵塞和出血。

- CT或MRI脑部影像帮助确定卒中类型、部位和范围。
- 血液检查、心电图及必要的血管超声等帮助寻找原因。
- 只靠面部表情或症状持续时间，无法可靠决定应使用哪种治疗。
text.en:
Tests must rapidly distinguish a blockage from bleeding.

- Brain CT or MRI helps identify type, location and extent.
- Blood tests, an ECG and selected vessel ultrasound help investigate causes.
- Facial appearance or symptom duration alone cannot reliably determine treatment.

text.zh-CN:
短暂恢复不代表没有脑血管问题。

- 短暂性脑缺血发作简称TIA，症状可较快消失，却是重要警报。
- 缺血和出血可能表现相似，需影像区分。
- 其他问题也能出现类似表现，但应由急救团队排查，不在家通过等待来鉴别。
text.en:
Brief recovery does not exclude a vascular problem.

- A transient ischaemic attack, or TIA, may resolve quickly but is a serious warning.
- Ischaemic and haemorrhagic strokes can look similar and need imaging.
- Other conditions can mimic stroke, but emergency clinicians should distinguish them rather than waiting at home.

text.zh-CN:
急性治疗与后期康复承担不同任务。

- 部分血管堵塞可用溶栓药或取栓手术恢复血流，是否适用取决于时间、影像及风险。
- 出血性卒中可能需要控制病情或手术处理，不能照搬堵塞的用药。
- 病情稳定后，康复团队帮助恢复活动、言语及日常生活能力。
text.en:
Acute treatment and rehabilitation have different jobs.

- Selected blockages may receive clot-dissolving medicine or clot-removal procedures, depending on timing, imaging and risk.
- Bleeding strokes may need stabilisation or surgery and cannot use the same medicine plan automatically.
- Once stable, rehabilitation supports movement, speech and daily activities.

text.zh-CN:
药物必须匹配卒中类型和出血风险。

- 不要自行用家中抗凝药或其他药物处理疑似新卒中，先急救评估。
- 长期可能需要降压、降脂或针对特定病因的抗凝治疗，由团队选择。
- 抗凝药可导致严重出血；黑便、呕血、无法止血或服药期间头部严重撞击，应立即求助。
text.en:
Medicines must match the stroke type and bleeding risk.

- Do not self-treat suspected new stroke with stored anticoagulants or other medicines; seek emergency assessment.
- Long-term care may include blood-pressure, cholesterol or cause-specific anticoagulant treatment chosen by the team.
- Anticoagulants can cause serious bleeding; black stools, vomiting blood, bleeding that will not stop or a major head injury while taking them needs immediate help.

text.zh-CN:
饮食首先要保证吞咽安全。

- 卒中后可能吞咽困难，出现吃喝时呛咳、进食困难应告诉团队。
- 按吞咽评估建议选择食物和饮料质地；必要时需管饲，不能只靠强行喂水补充营养。
- 恢复期兼顾足够营养和血管健康，具体方案由吞咽及营养状况决定。
text.en:
Safe swallowing comes first in nutrition.

- Stroke can cause swallowing difficulty; report coughing or difficulty with food and drinks.
- Use the food and drink textures advised after swallowing assessment; tube feeding may be needed instead of forcing fluids.
- Recovery nutrition must balance adequate intake and vascular health, tailored to swallowing and nutritional status.

text.zh-CN:
康复应围绕可做到的具体任务。

- 按团队安排练习移动、穿衣和日常活动，逐步调整目标。
- 言语、认知、情绪和疲劳问题也需要支持，并非只有肢体训练。
- 根据功能安排家居辅助设备、照护和复工计划，避免独自承担全部困难。
text.en:
Rehabilitation should use achievable everyday tasks.

- Practise movement, dressing and daily activities with goals adjusted by the team.
- Speech, thinking, mood and fatigue deserve support alongside limb exercises.
- Plan home aids, care support and return to work according to function.

text.zh-CN:
脑卒中可以发生在任何年龄。

- 不要因患者年轻而忽略突然的神经症状。
- 妊娠相关高血压、子痫前期或产后人群出现相关症状也应紧急处理。
- 已有残疾或高龄者的康复方案需要适配原有功能、目标及照护条件。
text.en:
Stroke can occur at any age.

- Young age does not make sudden neurological symptoms safe to ignore.
- Pregnancy-related hypertension, pre-eclampsia or the postpartum period also warrant urgent attention to stroke signs.
- Rehabilitation for older people or those with disability should fit prior function, goals and available care.

text.zh-CN:
恢复速度存在很大差异。

- 有人在数天或数周明显改善，也有人需要数月或数年支持。
- 复诊检查血压、用药、复发风险和康复目标是否合适。
- 同时评估吞咽、情绪、认知和照护需求，持续困难仍可继续寻求帮助。
text.en:
Recovery rates vary greatly.

- Some improve over days or weeks; others need months or years of support.
- Follow-up reviews blood pressure, medicines, recurrence risks and rehabilitation goals.
- Swallowing, mood, cognition and care needs also need reassessment; persistent difficulties still deserve help.

text.zh-CN:
后果取决于受损脑区和严重程度。

- 可能遗留无力、步行困难、言语或理解障碍。
- 吞咽、记忆、视力及大小便控制也可能受影响。
- 情绪低落和疲劳可能持续；这些问题需要针对性康复和支持。
text.en:
Effects depend on the brain area and severity.

- Weakness, walking difficulty and speech or understanding problems may persist.
- Swallowing, memory, vision and bladder or bowel control can also be affected.
- Low mood and fatigue may continue and need targeted rehabilitation and support.

text.zh-CN:
预防包括处理血管风险和防止再次发作。

- 按计划管理高血压、糖尿病、血脂及房颤等已知问题。
- 戒烟，逐步规律活动，并采用适合自己的均衡饮食。
- 坚持复诊和已开具的预防药；新发症状仍需立即急救。
text.en:
Prevention addresses vascular risks and another stroke.

- Follow the plan for blood pressure, diabetes, blood fats and atrial fibrillation.
- Stop smoking, build regular activity and use a suitable balanced diet.
- Continue reviews and prescribed prevention medicines; new symptoms still require emergency help.
